title: HabitatDefinition
description: Deterministic spatial ecological semantic region definition. Decoupled from biological consequences.

habitat_id.description: Unique canonical identifier for the habitat instance

region.description: Spatial geometry/region defining bounds of this habitat

priority.description: Deterministic resolution priority when regions overlap (higher integer takes precedence)

temperature_modifier.description: Additive temperature delta in Celsius applied to macro EnvironmentState

humidity_modifier.description: Additive humidity delta applied to macro EnvironmentState (clamped [0.0, 1.0])

light_level_modifier.description: Additive or multiplicative factor for ambient light modifier

shelter_security_baseline.description: Default security factor of open terrain in this habitat [0.0, 1.0]
